Daily Devotional

February 5

4 Ye are of God, little children, and have overcome them: because greater is he that is in you, than he that is in the world. (1 John 4:4 KJV)

John had just been talking about the spirit of antichrist (1 John 4:3), and he is telling us, who have been saved, that we have the spirit of Jesus in us (Galatians 4:6), and He is greater than any of the other spirits that are in the world. Of course the one that is in the world is the devil and his demons, and Jesus has already made a show of Satan, and totally defeated him (Revelation 12:10-12).

This is such a profound truth, as the devil is the one that keeps trying to put sickness, diseases and all kinds of calamities on us, as he comes only to steal, kill, and destroy us (John 10:10). But He that is in us is greater than all the devil has in this world. If the born again Christian could ever totally understand what Jesus has given us, that lives on the inside of us, then we would be able to reap the benefits of all the Spiritual blessing that we have been given through His atonement (Romans 8:18). We have the ability to do all that Jesus did while on earth, as He told us to do the works He did (John 14:12), and even greater works. Wow, we should be out there laying hands on the sick, casting out devils, and even raising the dead. If we would all start doing that, then we wouldn’t need to pray for revival, as we would have one underway right then. That is the way to have a revival, not pray to God for one. God is waiting for us to do as He told us to do, then revival will come. Praise God for Jesus.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
